section_title: Section 185. Driving by a drunken person or by a person under the influence of drugs.
section_text: Section 185 — Whoever, while driving or attempting to drive a motor vehicle, has, in his blood, alcohol exceeding 30 mg. per 100 ml. of blood detected in a test by a breath analyser shall be punishable for the first offence with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both. For a second or subsequent offence, imprisonment may extend to two years, or fine up to fifteen thousand rupees, or with both.
